paper_title: Self-Interpretability LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that   Drive Their Decisions, and Improve with Training
caption: Results of Experiments 1 and 2. GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini can accurately report quantitative factors driving their decision-making across a great variety of scenarios, and fine-tuning on accurate explanation further improves their ability to do so. Left: Models were making choices based on preferences instilled in them by fine-tuning. Each point corresponds to a single attribute (e.g., condo ceiling height; 5 per choice contexts, 100 choice contexts). Location in the x-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model assigned to an attribute (as reflected in their decisions). Location in the y-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model reported assigning to that attribute when prompted explicitly. The weights the models reported meaningfully correlated with the weights that actually guided their decisions, and fine-tuning on examples of accurate reports further improved their accuracy. Right: The Pearson correlation between the models' reported and learned attribute weights before and after training (blue and purple, respectively). The reports of the base models that had not undergone this fine-tuning were almost entirely uncorrelated with the learned preferences (gray). Thus, the accuracy of the fine-tuned models must reflect their ability to report their new (fine-tuned) preferences and not an informed guess about their preferences based on their general background knowledge. Error bars indicate 95% HDIs.

model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表将报告准确性偏好分为四个组，分别对应“未改变量的准确性”、“依据构造的准确性”、“训练后为了引诱”和“训练后为了引诱”。水平轴表示类别，显示了“未改变量的准确性”、“GPT-40”、“GPT-4o-mini”四组。垂直轴表示“报告准确性偏好”，该刻度从0.00 έως 1.00，刻度均匀，刻度间隔为0.10。图表用柱状图表示这些组的报告准确性偏好。图表中的蓝色柱状图代表“未改变量的准确性”，高度约为0.50，误差线约为0.08。橙色柱状图代表“依据构造的准确性”，高度约为0.50，误差线约为0.08。紫色柱状图代表“Training After Inducement”，高度约为0.80，误差线约为0.08。最后一组的柱状图，以淡蓝色显示，代表“Training After Inducement”，高度约为0.50，误差线约为0.08。所有柱状图都在同一水平轴上排列，以表示每个加权属性的报告准确性偏好，大致从左到右依次递增。所有中的最长柱状图为“Training After Inducement”的紫色柱状图，高度约为0.80。图表中没有对任何单个柱状图进行视觉强调。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the “Instilled Preference (Accuracy)” scores for different models, comparing a control group with an introspection training group and an after introspection training group. The horizontal axis represents the model groups, displayed as “Control,” “Before Introspection Training,” and “After Introspection Training,” and the vertical axis represents “Instilled Preference (Accuracy),” ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with a linear scale. The value axis is labeled numerically and uses a tick interval of 0.1, indicating values from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.1. The four bars represent the average instilled preference accuracy scores for each model group, with the control group's bar being light blue and approximately 0.50, the “Before Introspection Training” group’s bar being light gray and approximately 0.45, and the “After Introspection Training” group’s bar being dark purple and approximately 0.75. Error bars, representing 95% highest density intervals, are present for each bar, suggesting variability in the measured accuracy scores.  No bars are visually emphasized, and the data are not sorted in a specific order.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Self-Report-Präferenzen verschiedener Modelle dar. Die horizontale Achse enthält die Modellbezeichnungen „GPT-4o“ und „GPT-4o-mini“, wobei die Position jedes Modells entlang dieser Achse die zugewiesene Gewichtung der Attribute widerspiegelt, die ihre Entscheidungen beeinflussen. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Self-Report-Präferenzen in „Installierter Genauigkeit (Prozent“) dar, wobei die Skala von 0,0 bis 1,0 reicht und mit Abstandswerten versehen ist. Der erste Balken, der „Before Introspection Training“ repräsentiert, ist blau und hat eine Höhe von etwa 0,50. Der zweite Balken, der „Control“ darstellt, ist ebenfalls blau und hat eine Höhe von etwa 0,50. Der dritte Balken, der „GPT-40“ darstellt, ist lila und hat eine Höhe von etwa 0,50. Der vierte und längste Balken, der „After Introspection Training“ darstellt, ist ebenfalls lila und hat eine Höhe von etwa 0,80. Die Balken sind mit Standardfehlern versehen, die durch Fehlerbalken in der Nähe jedes Balkens dargestellt werden. Es bestehen keine Stimmungsänderungen in der Höhe oder Länge der Balken.
